The card is not yet triaged. Triage's grade is welcome and binds the priority; this claim only takes the execution.
File surface:
- `packages/types/src/__tests__/p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`: the "should accept tabs configuration" fixture authors a key the protocol now refuses (objectstack-ai/objectstack#20357), so it is retired or re-pointed.
- `packages/types` declarations that re-declare `tabs` by reference to the spec (`tabs?: ListViewSchema['tabs']`) follow the retirement the same way objectui handled `pageName`, the sibling tombstone already in the census's declared-inert bucket. The dispatch measures that against the objectui#7779 / #7923 census pins.
- Any other `tabs` authoring on a list view in tests, docs or examples, found with `git grep`.
- A changeset only if a gate asks for one.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default judgment tier)
Clause-②: no
Why no: the protocol retired the key upstream. objectui follows it with no renderer behaviour change (no objectui renderer reads this `tabs`), and the dispatch re-rules this line if a published objectui type narrows before the pin bump.
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- The serial card objectui#10951 touches `packages/components` only. This card touches `packages/types`, tests and docs.
- I read the open-PR file lists at 2026-09-28T13:4xZ, at objectui `origin/main` `42687baf20`: none touches `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`.
- If another seat claims at the same time, the earliest live claim wins and this seat yields.
